target_customer: Companies building AI sales, recruiting and growth products that need company, people and jobs data
problem: Data vendors are expensive and stale, so teams building AI SDRs and recruiters struggle to get fresh contact and company data by API.
business_model: Usage based data API plus credits for verified emails and phones
product_category: B2B data APIs for AI sales and recruiting

founders.name: Adi Agashe
previous_startups: A profitable seven figure e-commerce business
founders.background_notes: YC page. Co-author of three books with Neel Mehta.

founders.name: Neel Mehta
previous_startups: A profitable seven figure e-commerce business

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and refreshing data on hundreds of millions of people and companies from many providers and live sources is data engineering heavy but not research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Freshness and price are the edge, and data resellers compete on both, so the position is easy to attack.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established; comparison pages list these as rivals today.

market_need_then: Not documented at founding. The YC page says customers include Ramp, Docusign and others, but without dates.

branding.domain_note: Operates at fiber.ai per the site.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Comparative and price led, claiming ten times cheaper data.

branding.brand_signature: Ten times cheaper than incumbents price claim
branding.community_and_virality: Founders are described as authors of bestselling books; searches also surface a different company called Fibr AI.

brand_strength.rationale: Search results mix it up with Fibr AI and no press on the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Fiber AI sells data APIs for AI sales and recruiting products, pricing aggressively against incumbents and serving enterprises and startups per its own claims. Funding evidence is weak and conflicting, so the capital history is unknown. The business is still active with a small team, and its edge rests on price and freshness rather than structural moat.
notes: A 4.3 million dollar seed dated August 2023 with Rebel Fund and Soma Capital is attributed to Forbes but appears only via a Seedtable summary and aggregator pages, and CB Insights shows 500 thousand dollars, so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. Another source names TRAC as a seed investor, also unverified. No dated competitor sources near mid 2023 were found, so the list is empty. Update: the $4.3M seed dated 2023-08 (Forbes 30 Under 30 attribution, as shown by Seedtable; VCBacked dates it 2024-01) is now recorded. The Forbes page itself was not opened, and CB Insights conflicts with about $500K over 5 rounds.
